during-the-depths-of-despair.player: Hello. I'm helping Lord Hosidius find his missing son. I was wondering if you could help me.

during-the-depths-of-despair.npc: I'm afraid I know not where Artur has gone. I do not speak to him much. He keeps himself to himself.
However, I've noticed him speaking to Olivia before. Maybe she can help.

during-the-depths-of-despair-after-talki.npc: Good day [sir/madam]. I hope your quest is going well.

after-completing-the-depths-of-despair.npc: Good day [sir/madam]. On behalf of the Hosidius family, I thank you for bringing Artur home.

after-completing-a-kingdom-divided.npc: Good day [sir/madam]. I'm afraid I can't stop to talk. The new Lord Hosidius has plenty of work for me.
